about_the_game:
Deck building

The deck is the body and the cards its members. Congregation is only just as holy as its weakest link.
Joshua 24:15
"...choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell..."

Story mode

Play through the books of the bible made alive and unlock rewards!
1 Timothy 6:12
"Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you made your good confession in the presence of many witnesses."

Player VS Player

Casual and ranked mode.
Galatians 5:15
"But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another."

Tribulation Arena

Battle online for increasing rewards with limited deck building.
1 Peter 4:12
Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:

Card Collection

Fill your collection by buying or opening packs.
Matthew 6: 20-21
"But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also."

Classes

Shepherd - Animals of the earth are you friends. You protect them and they provide for you. The more the merrier.

Naturalist - A child of nature, your power flows from natural growth. Your options branch and spread, like the plants that thrive under your care.

Saint - Blessed by God, you are called to heal and build what is left to ruin and destruction. Your hands rebuild what sin and strife have undone.

Sorcerer - The enemy of all good, you pay a terrible price to gain temporary power, your power is vast, your torment certain.

Lawful - Crowned by divine right, your word is command and your will is law. Under your rule, men and nations prosper with a blessing.

Outlaw - A criminal, thief, and robber, your life is defined by murder, plot, and betrayal. Gold is your god, and betrayal your prayer.

Peacekeeper - Align yourself with the Holy will of The Creator and overwhelm your adversaries with supernatural miracles and divine strength.

Warmonger - Weapons of destruction are your instruments by day; the blood of your adversaries trails you by night. You live for the conflict.

Machine - A disembodied spirit in a man-made vessel, your unholy passion is to enslave and destroy mankind. Tech is your realm, and all machines march for you.

content_descriptors.notes: Content can trigger emotional reactions to those who are very opinionated of their world views and intolerant of other's culture and beliefs.
